verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents its own ways to get data out of a sandbox. Users can copy files with standard `scp` over SSH and read persistent files through the Files API without starting compute. Logs and the audit ledger are also readable via API. These yield ordinary files, but nothing documents a dedicated bulk export or full account takeout. missing for 10: documented bulk/full-account data export, export of snapshots/templates/RootFS in an open portable format, export of logs/audit data in specified open formats, migration/offboarding guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Use standard SSH clients to open a shell inside a sandbox or copy files with `scp`.
Read and manage persistent files without starting or resuming sandbox compute.
Sandbox0 provides runtime metrics, historical logs, and a signed audit ledger for each sandbox. These APIs read historical data without waking a paused sandbox.
